title: Memory Duel
description: A memory battle where you hide the cards. Every pair is split: you secretly place your half, your opponent places theirs. Flip one of your cards, then find its twin among theirs before they find yours. On harder modes the board turns, rows slide and chaos events hit between turns, so you have to track every move. Items like Peek, Scanner and Double Points, streak combos, a 10-level campaign, a daily challenge with a leaderboard, 2 players on one device and online 1v1.
